texts.preamble: Del Monte Foods Private Limited vs Additional District Magistrate Budgam ... ..... Petitioner(s) Through: M/S Iqra Khalid and Numan Zargar, Advocates. V/s Additional District Magistrate Budgam & Ors. .....Respondent(s)
texts.facts: 1 Through the medium of this petition, the petitioner has sought quashment of order dated 17th October 2023 passed in File No. 451 by the Respondent No. 1 i.e. Additional District Magistrate Budgam (Adjudicating Officer under SRO 353 dated 29th November 2011 of Food Safety & Standards, Act 2006) in case titled UT of Jammu and Kashmir through Food Safety Officer, Budgam vs M/S Mir Provisional Store & Others, whereby the Adjudicating Officer (under the Food Safety & Standards, Act 2006), Budgam has imposed a penalty of Rs. 5.00 lakhs (Rupees Five Lakhs), with further condition that non-deposition of the penalty shall entail cancellation of the license.
texts.arguments: The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the quantum of penalty provided is Rs. 3.00 lakhs (Rupees Three Lakhs) instead of Rs. Rs. 5.00 lakhs (Rupees Five Lakhs) as imposed by the Adjudicating Officer and the other conditions are also not provided under Section 52 of the Food Safety & Standards, Act 2006, as have been imposed. Heard. Notice in the main petition as well as in connected CM, returnable within a period of four weeks. List on 26th December 2023. In the meantime, subject to objections from the other side and till the next date of hearing before the Bench, the impugned order dated 17 th October 2023 passed in File No. 451 by the Respondent No. 1 i.e. Additional District Magistrate, Budgam in case titled UT of Jammu and Kashmir through Food Safety Officer, Budgam vs M/S Mir Provisional Store & Others, shall remain stayed. (M. A. CHOWDHARY) JUDGE SRINAGAR: 15.11.2023 "Hamid" Del Monte Foods Private Limited vs Additional District Magistrate Budgam ...
